definition: Paul John Werbos (born September 4, 1947) is an American social scientist and machine learning pioneer.
details: First described the process of training artificial neural networks via backpropagation of errors in his 1974 PhD dissertation. He also was a pioneer of recurrent neural networks. Werbos was one of the original three two-year Presidents of the International Neural Network Society (INNS). In 1995, he was awarded the IEEE Neural Network Pioneer Award for the discovery of backpropagation and other basic neural network learning frameworks, such as Adaptive Dynamic Programming. Werbos has also written on quantum mechanics and other areas of physics.

explainer.lead: Paul Werbos is an American social scientist and machine learning pioneer (born 1947). His work spans social science.
